notes.title: First Week of Destruction: 244 Trees Planted & Patch v1.0.1
notes.content:
Destroy The World is making its way around the globe!
Tell your friends! Everyone can destroy the world!

[h1][b]With the help of its fellow destroyers, we already replanted 244 trees![/b][/h1]

With the help of your feedback, I have fixed the following (v1.0.1):

[list]
[*] added voice volume option
[*] mouse control for attacks
[*] added loading sequence pause on level load, for readability
[*] fixed going-through-floor issue in level 'Nucular'
[*] lowered win tolerance abit for convenience ;)
[/list]

Stay tuned for further updates!

[h1]Happy Destroying![/h1]
